episode.title: A Single Egg
episode.premise: The Regular wants to buy one egg. The store sells eggs by the dozen.
episode.hook: A woman is already arguing about eggs before the clip has finished loading.

look.film: Expired 16mm stock; halation around every light source; grain visible in shadows.
look.lens: Wide 28mm at chest height; slight edge barrel distortion; focus hunts briefly before settling.
look.lighting: Only practical room sources; one source dominant and everything else falling to black.
look.palette: Sodium-vapor amber against cold fluorescent green, with one saturated red object.
look.grade: Crushed blacks and blown highlights; no lifted shadows.
look.texture: Fingerprints, condensation, dust in light, and frequently touched surfaces.
look.default_camera: Locked-off wide with no movement; bystander framing.

inheritance.series_override: Hold one frame longer than feels comfortable before anything moves.
inheritance.audio_bed: Fluorescent hum, cooler compressor cycling, and distant traffic through glass.
negative_intent: shallow depth of field on wide shots

the-regular.name: The Regular
the-regular.lock: Early-30s wiry white woman; wet dark hair pushed back; oversized mechanic's jacket with name patch torn off; sleep shorts; unlaced boots; face-down phone held in one hand; chipped black nail polish.
the-regular.delivery: Quick, mid-thought, as though continuing a conversation.

vic.name: Vic
vic.lock: Late-40s heavy-set Black man; close-shaved head greying at temples; wire-frame glasses on forehead; oversized faded navy store polo with soft collar; empty lanyard; forearms on counter.
negative_intent: glasses not worn on face in this episode

the-counter.name: The Counter
the-counter.lock: Scratched laminate convenience-store counter; lottery dispenser, worn-key register, lighter box, empty hot-dog roller, clerk-facing security monitor, half-empty cigarette racks, and one flickering fluorescent tube; black windows reflect the interior.

aisle-three.name: Aisle Three
aisle-three.lock: Narrow aisle with glass-doored coolers left, motor oil and windshield fluid right, green cooler light on wet-looking tile, one internally fogged door, and darkness at the far end.
negative_intent: wet-floor sign never moved or removed

wet-floor-sign.name: The Wet Floor Sign
wet-floor-sign.lock: Yellow folding WET FLOOR sign, scuffed with one cracked panel, upright on dry tile.

single-egg.name: Single egg
single-egg.continuity_role: Removed from the twelve-egg carton in shot 3 and placed between the characters in shot 4.

shots.action: The Regular is already leaning on the counter mid-sentence, tapping the laminate once per word; her phone is face-down beside her hand.
shots.camera: Locked-off wide at chest height; counter across bottom third; flickering tube at top edge.

dialogue.line: So do you sell one egg.

shots.added_audio: A fingernail tapping laminate four times.

continuity.incoming: Establish canonical counter, The Regular, and face-down phone.
continuity.outgoing: The Regular's finger is stopped mid-tap, resting on the counter.

shots.action: Vic does not look up from the security monitor. He turns one delivery-pad page while The Regular waits with her whole body.
shots.camera: Same locked-off wide, unchanged; Vic is the only new information.

continuity.incoming: Retain shot 1 counter framing, The Regular lock, and face-down phone; add canonical Vic behind the counter.
continuity.outgoing: Vic's hand is flat on the closed delivery pad; glasses remain on his forehead.

shots.action: The Regular considers a twelve-egg carton before the open cooler, removes one egg, and returns the carton to the shelf.
shots.camera: Locked-off wide down the aisle; wet-floor sign near frame; darkness at far end.
shots.added_audio: A cooler-door seal releasing, then closing.

continuity.incoming: Planned move to canonical Aisle Three; retain The Regular appearance and face-down-phone locks; wet-floor sign upright in its fixed position.
continuity.outgoing: One egg is held at chest height in an otherwise empty hand; cooler door swings shut behind her.

shots.action: The Regular sets the single egg on the counter. Vic looks at the egg, not her. Neither moves for the rest of the shot.
shots.camera: Return to the same locked-off counter wide, held past comfort; only the fluorescent tube changes.
shots.added_audio: An egg set down on laminate, then only the inherited room bed.

continuity.incoming: Carry the shot 3 egg into the canonical shot 1–2 counter frame; restore Vic's shot 2 appearance, glasses, and counter position; retain The Regular locks.
continuity.outgoing: The egg is alone at the centre of the counter between them; the episode remains unresolved.

post_plan.caption: he's not going to charge her for it and she knows that
